title: spectrace.json
description: SpecTrace configuration. Marks the repository root for the analyzer and the CLI.

specs.description: Folder with the *.spec.md files, relative to this file.

sources.description: Folders with the code and tests scanned by the CLI (report, context, get_code...).

trackers.description: Issue trackers that user stories come from.

repository.description: owner/repo. Default: GITHUB_REPOSITORY, then the origin remote.

label.description: Label of the issues that are user stories. Empty: all issues.

url.description: Web address, for GitHub Enterprise Server.

apiUrl.description: REST API address. Default: https://api.github.com, or <url>/api/v3 for GitHub Enterprise Server.
